scale: Each pillar is scored 0-10 on an anchored rubric (see career/02-roles/role-rankings.md section 1). lo/mid/hi = plausible range given evidence quality; Monte Carlo samples a triangular distribution (lo, mid, hi).
grades: EGP-1.0 grades of the evidence behind each pillar: A primary record; B authoritative secondary or platform aggregate with disclosed method (JobsPipe, Fast AI Jobs and Levels.fyi pages are B); C practitioner, small-corpus or vendor survey; D judgement or recalled; M model output from graded inputs (treated as C for confidence).
